docs.summary: A dynamic bounding-volume hierarchy for sets that change every frame (moving physics bodies, etc.). Leaves are inserted, removed, and moved individually with incremental tree rotations instead of a full rebuild. Each leaf is stored with a fattened AABB (its tight bounds enlarged by [`Margin`](#api~Prowl.Vector.Spatial.DynamicBvh~Margin)). While an object moves inside its fat box nothing in the tree changes, so small per-frame motion is nearly free; a re-insertion only happens once the object leaves its margin. Optionally the fat box can be extended along the object's motion to anticipate travel. Items are referenced by a stable integer proxy id returned from [`Add`](#api~Prowl.Vector.Spatial.DynamicBvh~Add). Overlap and ray queries are conservative (they test the fat boxes), so callers should do an exact narrow-phase test on the returned items.

typeparams.T: The item type stored at each leaf.
